Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: TGT Sanskrit: Bachelor's Degree with at least 50% marks in Sanskrit as main subject; B.Ed. or equivalent; CTET Paper-II qualified; Proficiency in Hindi and English medium teaching. content_sections.heading: PM SHRI KV Rajnandgaon Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for PM SHRI KV Rajnandgaon Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the walk-in date for the PM SHRI KV Rajnandgaon recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the TGT Sanskrit and Counsellor posts at PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Rajnandgaon is scheduled for 28 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The available posts are TGT Sanskrit and Counsellor. There is one vacancy for each post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for TGT Sanskrit?
faq.answer: For TGT Sanskrit, candidates need a Bachelor's Degree with at least 50% marks in Sanskrit, B.Ed. or equivalent, and CTET Paper-II qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for the Counsellor post?
faq.answer: The qualification for the Counsellor post is a B.A./B.Sc. in Psychology and a Diploma/Certificate in Counselling. Experience in school counselling is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. How should candidates apply for these positions?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview with all required documents on the specified date.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q8. Where is PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Rajnandgaon located?
faq.answer: PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Rajnandgaon is located in Rajnandgaon, Chhattisgarh, with the pincode 491441.

faq.question: Q9. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.
